game.name: Barbie And Her Sisters Puppy Rescue (USA)
game.desc: Players will join Barbie and her sisters as they work together to rescue and train lost puppies in beautiful 3D. Set in Barbie's hometown of Willows, Wisconsin, and inspired by the upcoming Barbie and Her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure DVD, players will join Barbie and her sisters ? Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea? as they solve clues to find and rescue lost puppies in need. Each sister will bring her own unique set of skills and activities to the game. Players can groom puppies at Chelsea's Pup Care, or teach them new games at Pup Camp with Stacie, resulting in a game full of opportunities for the girls to rescue, feed, groom and ultimately have fun with the playful puppies!
